title: .dev-workflow/autopilot-state.json
description: The machine-readable state the autopilot tick reads and writes, on the main workspace (repo root) only. Every field a tick may set is declared here; a tick that wants to record something not in this document is recording meaning no other consumer can read. Written by the atomic-write protocol in state-schema.md so a mid-write crash cannot corrupt it.

status.description: Whether the driver dispatches new work. paused keeps existing workspaces running and stops dispatch; stopped ends the loop.

last_tick_at.description: ISO8601 of the last completed tick

tick_in_progress.description: The tick lock: ISO8601 of the tick currently running, null when none is. A tick that finds this set and younger than 4 minutes skips; older than that, it is a crashed tick's stale lock and the next tick clears it.

workspaces.description: Keyed by workspace name (the worktree directory name).

escalations.description: Open and acknowledged escalations, newest last. An escalation is the driver telling a human what it cannot decide.

guard_state.description: Post-merge guard state keyed by story_id, so a tick is idempotent: deploy-once, dogfood-once, revert-once, escalate-once. See references/post-merge-guard.md.

backend.description: Executor mode this workspace was launched under. Decides which handle agent_id carries and which liveness probe applies — see /aep-executor.

agent_id.description: Handle for nudge / liveness / teardown, whose shape follows backend: bg-subagent id (bare hex), bg session id, codex agent id, exec session id, or tmux session name.

phase.description: Current /aep-build phase, from the workspace's status.json signal

story_status.description: Mirrored from the workspace's own signal. The control-plane states (pending, ready, blocked, deferred) never appear here — a workspace only reports on work it owns.

failure_log.description: Structured failure carried up from the workspace signal

consecutive_stuck_ticks.description: Ticks whose progress and liveness hash both failed to change

last_liveness_hash.description: Hash of the backend's liveness-probe output at the last tick (TaskList entry / worktree-activity probe / logs tail / worker.log / tmux pane). Null on the first tick and after a restart.

last_action.description: What the driver last did to this workspace. The tick reads it to stay idempotent — an action already taken is not retaken.

x-aep-stages.readopted: orphaned worker re-spawned into the existing worktree
x-aep-stages.review_re_triggered: gen/eval re-triggered after a stuck run
x-aep-stages.merge_stuck_nudged: stronger nudge sent for a stuck Phase 12
x-aep-stages.nudged: stuck nudge sent via executor nudge

x-aep-stages.environment_repair: a gate or dogfood preflight REFUSED on unmet preconditions — an environment failure, not a product one. Unlike every other type it does not pause dispatch of the remaining in-layer stories, and it self-clears: the refusing gate re-probes each tick and resumes when the probes pass.

workspace.description: Null when the story was never launched

reason.description: One line — what the driver could not decide

details.description: Enough for a human to act without reading the state file. For environment_repair this carries the ops checklist: every named REFUSING tag and the repair it implies.

expected_human_action.description: The concrete next command or edit

monitor_until.description: ISO8601 end of the window_min monitoring window

health.description: Last reading per configured health_signals key (e.g. ci_status, error_rate, health_endpoint)

escalated.description: Guards against a duplicate post_merge_regression escalation

history_entry.title: One line of .dev-workflow/autopilot-history.jsonl
history_entry.description: Append-only audit trail, one JSON line per tick. actions is the human-readable list of what the tick did, in order.
